NOTES: Single source of truth for the site's base URL. sitemap.xml, robots.txt, <link rel=canonical>, og:url and all JSON-LD site URLs are generated from BASE_URL. All internal href/src links in HTML files are relative (./, ../, tools/...) and need no change on a domain move. To migrate to a custom root domain (e.g. https://nexusai.com): 1) change BASE_URL here, 2) run goals/nexusai-by-kulbeer-brand-website/hidden_files/migrate-domain.py --new-base <new URL>, 3) push to main, 4) in Google Search Console add the new property, verify it, submit the new sitemap, and set a Change of Address from the old property. Keep the old GitHub Pages URL live with 301 redirects (via the new domain's hosting) until Google has fully moved the rankings.
